recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5228 unless a future work group decision changes how REST interaction syntax should be presented.
issue_request: FHIR-5228 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ballot clarification asking that the actual syntax for each command be shown in the section that describes the command and example, with create illustrated as POST https://example.com/path/{resourceType}.
initial_application: The request was applied in svn revision 4509, imported as git commit 5c0b63f72ba10a2b22e71f7ce3685b3aeb6ac7ee, which added explicit POST, GET, search, and PUT patterns to source/overview-dev.html.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml actively includes overview-dev.html as the Developer Introduction. Later editorial refactors replaced the older long examples with a concise Interactions list in overview-dev.html, while http.html now provides the detailed REST interaction sections. FHIR-5227 is an adjacent overview transaction-path clarification from the same ballot family but was not needed to decide this seed.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source already preserves the requested implementer-facing syntax through the active developer overview and linked REST API sections, and additional wording would duplicate maintained REST guidance.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent Published/Persuasive overview-dev transaction syntax clarification found during bounded Jira search; useful context but not decided by this seed audit.
